name: Old City of Dubrovnik
description: Dubrovnik, nicknamed the "Pearl of the Adriatic," is a walled port city on Croatia's Dalmatian coast. It grew rich as an independent maritime republic, and its Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque churches, palaces and fountains survived a devastating 1667 earthquake. Shelling in 1991 damaged it again, but careful restoration has returned its stone streets to life.
